rationale: Three hard-disjoint research corpora. No source may appear in more than one slice: slice A is ecosystem-native package-manager documentation, slice B is supply-chain integrity and SBOM standards bodies, slice C is polyglot build orchestration and version-solver literature. Shared evidence would fake corroboration, so the partition is by SOURCE KIND, not by topic phrasing.

slices.lens: What does each ecosystem's own package manager already guarantee, and where does it stop? Extract requirements for a uniform manager from the primitives that already exist.
slices.source_kind: official documentation of ecosystem-native package managers and their version-resolution/lockfile semantics
in_scope_sources: NuGet Central Package Management (Directory.Packages.props), floating versions, lock files
npm/pnpm/yarn: package.json ranges, lockfiles, workspaces, overrides/resolutions
Cargo: Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, semver rules, feature unification, workspace dependencies
Go modules: go.mod/go.sum, minimal version selection, replace/exclude
Dart pub: pubspec.yaml/pubspec.lock, dependency_overrides
Hex + rebar3 (Erlang/BEAM) and Gleam: gleam.toml, manifest.toml
Python: pyproject.toml/PEP 621, uv/Poetry/pip-tools lockfiles, PEP 440/508
Maven/Gradle: dependencyManagement BOM, Gradle version catalogs, conflict resolution strategies
AtomVM/embedded BEAM packaging constraints
excluded_sources: anything from slice B (security/SBOM/provenance standards bodies)
anything from slice C (polyglot build systems, solver papers, upgrade bots)

slices.lens: What must a package manager record, attest and verify for the dependency chain to be trustworthy and auditable? Extract requirements for provenance, integrity and vulnerability response.
slices.source_kind: supply-chain security frameworks, SBOM specifications and standards-body publications
in_scope_sources: SLSA build provenance levels
in-toto attestation framework
Sigstore / cosign signing and transparency logs
SPDX and CycloneDX SBOM specifications
OSV schema and OSV-Scanner; CVE/GHSA advisory formats
NIST SSDF (SP 800-218) and SP 800-161 supply-chain risk management
EU Cyber Resilience Act and US EO 14028 SBOM obligations
The Update Framework (TUF) and package-repository compromise resistance
Reproducible-builds requirements
excluded_sources: anything from slice A (ecosystem package-manager tool docs)
anything from slice C (build orchestrators, solver papers, upgrade bots)

slices.lens: How do polyglot build systems and version solvers actually resolve and prevent conflict across ecosystems? Extract requirements for the resolution engine, upgrade policy and conflict adjudication.
slices.source_kind: polyglot build-orchestration systems, dependency-resolution algorithm literature, and automated upgrade tooling
in_scope_sources: Bazel/Buck2/Pants: external dependency handling, hermeticity, rules_* per language
Nx / Turborepo / Lerna monorepo dependency graphs
PubGrub and CDCL/SAT-based version solving; libsolv; Molinillo
Diamond-dependency and dependency-hell literature; semantic-versioning critiques
Renovate and Dependabot: grouping, scheduling, auto-merge policy, compatibility scoring
Nix/Guix purely functional dependency management and closures
Conda/Spack multi-language environment resolution
Version-compatibility testing and API-diff tooling (e.g. semver-checks, japicmp)
excluded_sources: anything from slice A (ecosystem package-manager tool docs)
anything from slice B (security/SBOM/provenance standards bodies)
